notes: Implemented the unified certificate mapping (docs/CERTIFICATE_MAPPING.md rows A+B) onto the landed facet backend, edge-sample ledger, and evidence algebra. All four base types plus EnvelopeCase::ConstructRefused live in truck-base/src/evidence.rs (additive, V8-safe); FacetSweepResult gains realization_certificate (Method::Float, max_cell_twist tracked in the existing side-face loop, extent) and shared_edge_pairs (empty on the exact-grid path); From<FacetVerdict> for RealizationVerdict maps the three arms; facet_sweep_certified refuses ConstructError as Refusal::UnsupportedEnvelope(EnvelopeCase::ConstructRefused) and wraps Ok with a Method::Float Certificate (house field-by-field constructor, never Exact); truck-meshalgo gains tessellation/realization_evidence.rs (assemble + ledger_shared_edge_pairs) wired as pub mod in tessellation/mod.rs. All 8 tests_required names exist verbatim (5 in facet_sweep_conformance.rs, 3 in tests/realization_evidence.rs); every landed conformance test keeps its exact name and passes. Anchors are pre-dispatch state checks and all matched the packet's expect at dispatch; A2/A5/A7 now read 1/1/2 because the packet's own required additions put ConstructRefused in evidence.rs, realization_evidence in mod.rs, and shared_edge_pairs in facet_sweep.rs. DEVIATIONS (mechanical; mapping carrier unchanged): (1) ORPHAN RULE: the packet mandates `From<&ConstructError> for ConstructErrorSummary` in facet_sweep.rs, but rustc E0117 rejects it there (neither ConstructError nor ConstructErrorSummary is local to truck-modeling) and truck-geometry (where ConstructError is local) is outside write_allow; the mapping rides instead as `pub fn summarize_construct_error(&ConstructError) -> ConstructErrorSummary` in facet_sweep.rs — still the ONE modeling-local mapping site, base stays geometry-blind, and test facet_sweep_certified_refuses_with_construct_refused re-derives kind "ProfileCollapse" through it. (2) RETURN TYPE: the packet spells `Outcome<Certified<FacetSweepResult>>`, but in this tree Outcome<T> = Result<Certified<T>, Refusal> (truck-base evidence.rs), so that spelling would double-wrap; per the packet's own `// prelude Result<_, Refusal>` comment the intended expansion is Result<Certified<FacetSweepResult>, Refusal>, i.e. `Outcome<FacetSweepResult>`, and the body performs exactly the single Certified::new wrap the packet describes. (3) assemble's winding_violations parameter is interpreted as the mapping-A-row-4 doctrine (a non-zero winding-violation count is FAILED, never a warning): it forces RealizationVerdict::Failed; RealizationEvidence has no other slot for the count and an unused parameter would not compile clean. (4) ledger_shared_edge_pairs: the landed EdgeSampleLedger stores only integer position indices (no coordinates), so against the landed types the integer-identity check is the comparison and the "measured positional deviation" is the index deviation from the shared canonical sequence (face A's forward reading): identical sequences emit nothing (exactness by absence of rows), any mismatch emits one row with error_a = 0.0 (face A defines the canonical) and error_b = summed index deviation of reverse(B); nothing is welded, averaged, or rounded. GATES: cargo fmt --all -- --check clean for every write-set file (pre-existing fmt diffs remain in untouched examples/step_face_timing.rs and tests/geometry_fingerprint.rs, present at HEAD); cargo clippy -p truck-base -p truck-modeling -p truck-meshalgo --all-targets --message-format=short --no-deps reports zero findings in write-set files (pre-existing findings in untouched truck-meshalgo formal/diagnosis/triangulation source remain); cargo test -p truck-base --lib 33 passed; cargo test -p truck-modeling --lib --tests all green (lib 27, facet_sweep_conformance 15 incl. the 5 new); cargo test -p truck-meshalgo --lib --tests: realization_evidence 3 passed and ledger_identity 5 passed, but the landed debug-mode suite has PRE-EXISTING failures identical at base (verified by stashing my changes): cone_topology_tests::{duplicate_edge_creates_no_second_cdt_edge, test_parity_intersecting_constraints_rejected} and 7 tests in tests/tessellation; cargo check --workspace --all-targets green (no downstream EnvelopeCase exhaustive-match breaks).
